facts.fact: A GPE KIX blog with Togo's ministry officials says the ministry integrated its StatEduc data collection with DHIS2 into a system linking the planning, examinations and inspection directorates.
Togo's annual school census data is processed by StatEduc and DHIS2 gives subnational users dashboards on it, according to ministry officials.
